content.user_title: Export Java Telemetry to Azure Monitor
content.value_statement: Java teams need clear guidance when sending OpenTelemetry data to Azure Monitor. This skill explains exporter setup, tracing patterns, metrics, and migration to the recommended autoconfigure package.
actual_capabilities: Explains why the exporter is deprecated and points users to autoconfigure migration guidance.
Shows Maven dependency entries for the deprecated exporter and recommended autoconfigure package.
Describes connection string setup through an environment variable or explicit configuration.
Demonstrates spans, attributes, nested spans, exception recording, and custom span processors.
Introduces OpenTelemetry metrics with counters, histograms, attributes, and units.
Links to Maven, Azure SDK, OpenTelemetry, and Application Insights reference pages.
limitations: It is a documentation skill and does not modify project files automatically.
It references a deprecated exporter and recommends migration to autoconfigure.
It cannot validate live Azure Monitor resources or telemetry delivery.

use_cases.title: Instrument a Java service
use_cases.description: Add Azure Monitor tracing and metrics guidance to a Java service using OpenTelemetry examples.

use_cases.title: Plan exporter migration
use_cases.description: Replace deprecated exporter usage with the recommended autoconfigure package and related setup guidance.

use_cases.title: Review telemetry patterns
use_cases.description: Check span names, attributes, exceptions, counters, and histograms against practical observability patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Show basic setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a Java service
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain the recommended Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry setup for a new Java service. Include dependency choice, connection string handling, and first tracing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Move away from the deprecated exporter
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a migration plan from azure-monitor-opentelemetry-exporter to azure-monitor-opentelemetry-autoconfigure. Include risks, testing steps, and rollout checks.

prompt_templates.title: Instrument a workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Add tracing detail to an important operation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to recommend span names, attributes, exception recording, and nested span structure for a Java order processing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Review observability design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a Java telemetry design for Azure Monitor. Evaluate traces, metrics, custom processors, attribute quality, and migration readiness.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to start Azure Monitor telemetry in a Java service.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the recommended autoconfigure package, explains connection string setup, and outlines the minimum tracing steps.

output_examples.input: A team needs to migrate from the deprecated exporter.
output_examples.output: The response gives a migration checklist with dependency replacement, initialization updates, test validation, and rollout checks.

output_examples.input: An SRE wants better trace detail for a key workflow.
output_examples.output: The response recommends span names, useful attributes, exception recording, and related metric dimensions for Azure Monitor analysis.

best_practices: Use the autoconfigure package for new work unless a legacy exporter is required.
Keep real connection strings in secure environment configuration.
Validate telemetry in a test resource before production rollout.
anti_patterns: Starting new projects on the deprecated exporter without a migration plan.
Hardcoding real Application Insights connection strings in source files.
Adding high-cardinality attributes that make telemetry noisy or expensive.

faq.question: Does this skill install Azure packages?
faq.answer: No. It explains dependencies and setup steps, but package installation remains user-controlled.

faq.question: Is the exporter deprecated?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states the exporter is deprecated and recommends azure-monitor-opentelemetry-autoconfigure.

faq.question: Can it help with traces and metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers spans, attributes, exceptions, counters, and histograms in Java examples.

faq.question: Does it require a live Azure account?
faq.answer: No for reading guidance. A live Azure Monitor or Application Insights resource is needed to test telemetry.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive connection strings?
faq.answer: It shows placeholder configuration only. Users should store real connection strings in secure environment settings.
